meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'ткнуться'). Used in Russian as a perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to shut up'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.
